The figure on the right is a muscular man in a tank top, posing with fists raised. The background includes bold typography, a 'Lake & Sumter' banner, and various text elements like 'THE GREAT PUMPKIN!' and 'EXTRAORDINARY ISSUE'. The image has a high-contrast, illustrative style typical of comic book or action movie promotional art.
